description: Clarify the policy for docs livebooks that are explanatory rather than runnable, such as priv/pages/docs/reference/why-not-just-a-genserver.livemd. Either convert them to runnable notebooks, mark them clearly as non-runnable, or remove Livebook-oriented affordances and test expectations.

comments.text: Adopted the explicit reference-only policy: non-runnable docs Livebooks should set livebook.runnable to false, stay in the reference-only coverage list, and not get drift tests until promoted.

title: Decide how non-runnable reference Livebooks should be labeled or excluded
